retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel photographic collage featuring a large black header with centered, high-contrast serif typography and warm-toned cinematic stills arranged in an asymmetric grid.
triggerTerms: asymmetric photo grid with black header

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-panel photographic layout anchored by a solid black top bar containing three tiers of centered text. The imagery uses a warm, desaturated color palette with visible film grain, depicting human subjects in naturalistic, outdoor settings. The grid consists of one large vertical panel on the right and two smaller stacked horizontal panels on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Black header bar providing high-contrast grounding for white and red text
Asymmetric grid balancing one large vertical frame against two smaller horizontal frames
Consistent warm, earthy color grading across disparate photographic stills
Tight cropping on faces to emphasize emotional connection
coreInvariants: Solid black header occupying the top 20-25% of the frame
White display text as the central typographic anchor
Thin white gutters between photographic panels

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subjects are centered within their respective grid panels; the right-hand panel features a family group at a larger scale than the left-hand details.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white title text in the black header acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down from the header, then clockwise from the large right panel to the bottom-left and top-left panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the top; minimal white negative space used as gutters between photos.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Red (secondary text and warm skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast in the header; photographs feature warm mid-tones and crushed blacks.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy browns, tans, and muted reds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast bold serif for titles paired with a lighter, lower-contrast serif in a different color for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast transitional serif look of the 70s.
Provides the characteristic bracketed serifs and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-panel photo collage with a large vertical panel on the right and two stacked horizontal panels on the left, separated by thin white lines. Leave the top 25% of the canvas as a solid black bar. The photos should be warm-toned, grainy 1970s-style film stills of people in nature.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the black header, center three lines of text. The middle line should be large, bold, white serif all-caps. The top and bottom lines should be smaller, muted red serif text.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly three photo panels?
Is the main title white and the subtitle red?
Does the imagery have a warm, vintage film grain?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of header height to image height
mustRedesign: Specific faces and people from the original
Any specific movie or artist names

mustAchieve: Sharp contrast between black header and white text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grid lines are perfectly straight and thin.
Verify the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the red text is legible against the black background.
Confirm the photographic style is consistent across all panels.
recipe.reuseFormula: Black header + centered high-contrast serif typography + asymmetric multi-panel vintage film stills.
